title: Run a split coding job on a scratch repository and record it
goal: An agent run shows a refused small-context route and a two-step job with its handoff on a scratch repository
acceptance: On a scratch repository (as docs/acceptance/f084-scratch-repo-check.md), a route below the threshold is refused with its reason and a two-step job completes from its handoff; commands and output recorded in docs/acceptance/
privacy: Neutral fixtures and a scratch repository only; no personal data, no paid route.
escalation: A change of gate class, a paid route or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: the F-084-T04 procedure with two more checks, run by the agent. Not a measurement.
